_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The earth was formless, and darkness covered the deep.
God said: Let there be light. And there was light.
Through the flood, through the sea, through the long years of exile,
God led the people home.
Now on the third day the women come to the tomb,
and the stone is rolled away.
Wake, sleepers, and rise: this is the night the Lord has won.
Christ is risen! Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come into the dark with one small flame, and watch it pass from hand to hand until the whole room is burning with light.
God's mercy endures forever.
Remember the waters: the deep at creation, the flood that lifted the ark, the sea that opened a road for the running slaves.
God's mercy endures forever.
Remember the dry bones in the valley, and the breath that came and stood them on their feet, a living people where there had been a graveyard.
God's mercy endures forever.
And remember this morning's stone, rolled back from an empty grave while it was still dark.
God's mercy endures forever.
Lift the flame and lift your voice: the night is over, and the Lord is risen.
God's mercy endures forever. Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: One flame in the dark, and the whole room fills with light.
God's mercy endures forever.
Through flood and sea and dry valley, God brought the people home.
God's mercy endures forever.
The stone is rolled back while it is still night.
God's mercy endures forever.
Rise and worship: Christ is risen.
God's mercy endures forever. Alleluia!
